formattedAddress: No. 18號, Lane 455, Section 6, Roosevelt Rd, Jingxing Village, Wenshan District, Taipei City, Taiwan 116

text.text:
They said it would only take 5 minutes to fill out a questionnaire, but after being led into the store, I spent almost an hour listening to them promote their miracle weight-loss drink. There wasn't even a questionnaire!

At the beginning, I mentioned that I had lost over 20 kilograms through diet and exercise. They said my approach was too strenuous, and that drinking their drinks would make weight loss easy and make me healthier and more energetic.

(I already feel very healthy and energetic.)

Seeing how hard they were trying to sell the drinks, I bought a set—one of each of the three types—for $180 (no receipt). I asked how long it would take to see noticeable weight loss. They said I'd need to drink it for two weeks and buy at least 15 sets.

(10 sets $1700, 30 sets $4800. *Oops* This price could buy me several months' worth of gym memberships.)

Finally, seeing I was willing to spend, they went all out, saying I needed to change my diet and drink their beverages to get enough nutrients to change my physique.

(*Oops* I'm already eating a very healthy and balanced diet, otherwise how could I lose weight successfully?)

This sales pitch might work for beginners who want to lose weight easily but have no ideas. Anyone with even a basic understanding of fitness and dietary control will think they're talking nonsense.

Before leaving, I "strongly" insisted on taking the first two teas home (I really didn't want to waste time having to make a reservation and redeem them on-site). I thought I'd receive packaging like commercially available tea or coffee bags with instructions, but instead, it was just a random resealable bag containing a bunch of powder and unknown liquid, without even a tea name or any instructions on how to brew it (they were grumpy and had a bad attitude after only spending $180).

Taking these two small packets home, I had absolutely no desire to drink them (I have no idea what the ingredients are).

originalText.text:
說是花5分鐘幫忙填個問券，結果被帶進去店裡後花了快1小時在聽他們推銷減肥神飲。連個問券都沒有

一開始表明了我靠自己飲控+運動，減了20多公斤。對方說我這樣太辛苦了，只要喝他們的飲品就能輕鬆減重、讓自己變健康有活力。
（os我覺得自己現在已經很健康很有精神了）

看對方很努力的在推銷飲品，我抱著回饋的心態消費了一套飲料，3種各1共$180 無發票，並問對方我大概多久能有明顯的減脂成效。他說得喝到2週，最少需要消費15套以上。
（10套$1700、30套$4800  os好的這價錢我能去好幾個月的運動中心了）

最後看我願意消費，就加足馬力的說我得改變飲食習慣、加上配合飲用他們的飲品，一天的營養素才夠 才能改變體態
（os 我已經吃的很健康均衡了啊 不然怎麼能減肥成功==）

他們這套說詞或許適合想輕鬆減肥毫無想法的新手，但凡有一點健身基礎飲控概念 就會覺得對方在胡說八道

最後離開前，前面2種茶我‘強烈’要求自己帶回家喝（實在不想浪費時間還要我再預約、回去現場兌換），我以為拿到的會是類似市售茶包咖啡包有文字說明的包裝，結果是隨便用一個夾鏈袋裝著一堆粉和不知名液體，連個茶名是什麼都沒寫、怎麼泡也愛說不說（只消費$180 就臭臉+態度差）

拿著這2小包東西回家，完全沒有想喝的慾望（不知道裡面成份是什麼）

The best part is: Store manager Zihua is beautiful and incredibly kind! 🥰

我喝了三年本來頭髮稀疏，現在細毛都長出來了！整個精氣神都變好了！
重點是：梓華店長人美，待人親切🥰

text.text: I've become happier and more confident here, and I love the results! Losing 6.2kg in just over a month is incredible and makes me so happy. The store managers are all very friendly and patiently listen to and assist everyone based on their individual needs. My most anticipated and joyful moment each day is coming here for healthy meals; the atmosphere is always so warm and welcoming. 🥰

originalText.text: 我在這裡變得更快樂和自信，也很喜歡自身的效果。可以在一個多月內減6.2kg, 除了不可思議，也很開心。店長們都很友善，會依據不同人的需求，耐心聆聽和協助每個人～ 每天最期待和開心的事就是來這裡喝健康餐，氛圍也都很溫馨🥰
